notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Famished Paladin using Shu Farmer's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
